# Visual Diff Prompt

The robot was attempting this task: {task}

These two images show the scene BEFORE (left half) and AFTER (right half) the robot executed its code.

Describe specifically what changed between the two images. Focus on:
1. Did any object move? Where was it before and where is it now?
2. Did the robot gripper/arm position change?
3. Did the task goal get closer to being achieved?
Be specific about positions and spatial relationships.
